title: Twin Trees
statement: A garden planner stores two hedge layouts as binary trees. Return true if they are identical: the same shape, with the same value in every matching position.
constraints: 0 <= number of nodes in each tree <= 100

answerKey.pattern: Recursion on both trees at once
keyPoints: Both empty: identical; exactly one empty: different
Values at the roots must match
Then both left subtrees and both right subtrees must be identical
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Serialize both trees with null markers and compare the strings: O(n + m)

hints: When are two empty trees identical? When are an empty and a non-empty tree identical?
Compare the root values, then the left subtrees with each other and the right subtrees with each other.
Return false at the first difference.
